fix_subject: topn: guard dynamic filter pushdown against type-changing casts

labels.summary: Dynamic filter pushdown for TopN ignored type-changing casts between the sort key and the raw scan column, so sort-key-typed boundary constants were reinterpreted as the storage type, causing an assertion failure in assert builds and incorrect row-group pruning in release builds; the fix bails out of pushdown unless the scan column is type-identical to the sort key.
